mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 1% from its 6-month peak, it signals a coming supply crunch that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO peak-to-current decline exceeds 1pp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over 3 months, exceeding 0.5 percentage points, signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth slows by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will drag on economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth falls by > 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month from its 6-month peak, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS peak-to-current decline exceeds 100k jobs/mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth slows by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS y-o-y growth falls by > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a dangerous mix of high inflation and loose monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.
